instruction: Please enable the 'one instance when started from file' option in VLC Media Player. I want all my video files to open in the same VLC window instead of creating multiple instances.

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.click({SCREEN_WIDTH_HALF}, {SCREEN_HEIGHT_HALF}); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.explanation: Task requires enabling the 'one instance when started from file' setting in VLC (opposite of variation 4). The evaluator uses the existing check_one_instance_when_started_from_file metric to verify that the setting is set to 1 (enabled, which is the default). Similar difficulty but with opposite goal from variation 4.

llm_judge_reasons: The metric check_one_instance_when_started_from_file sets default value to '1' when the setting is not found in config file (vlc.py:509)
According to metadata, this setting is enabled by default in VLC, meaning the config file likely doesn't contain this line initially

The evaluator will pass (return 1) even if user does nothing, because: (1) default VLC likely has no explicit line for this setting, (2) metric defaults to '1' when not found, (3) expected value is '1'
Cannot distinguish between: user explicitly enabled the setting vs. user did nothing and VLC retained default behavior
The instruction asks to 'enable' the option, implying an action should be taken, but evaluator cannot verify any action was actually performed
Evaluator tests final state (setting=1) but not whether user changed anything, making it semantically incorrect for verifying task completion
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Change expected value to '1' AND ensure config file explicitly contains the line 'one-instance-when-started-from-file=1' (not just relying on default)
Modify metric to fail (return 0) when setting is not found in config, requiring explicit configuration
Add preconfig to explicitly disable the setting first (set to 0), so evaluator can verify user changed it from 0 to 1
Change instruction to 'disable' this option (set to 0) since that would require actual user action from the default state
